name: raglab-nhl-analytics
description: Provides quantitative NHL power ratings, team disparity models, player impact scores, and playoff simulation probabilities through a read-only MCP server.

bearerAuth.description: API key from https://sports.raglab.services/developers (Pro plan); read-only access.

skills.name: Power model
skills.description: Power metrics, history, cohort, similarity, and outlier analysis
examples: Rank all NHL teams by power score
Which teams are outliers on the penalty kill?

skills.name: Players & value
skills.description: Player dossiers, salary and contract value, and Power Above Average
examples: How much does Connor McDavid add to the Oilers?
Which players are the best value per cap dollar?

skills.name: Teams
skills.description: Season games, metric and projection histories, and schedule strength
examples: Which teams have the toughest remaining schedule?

skills.name: Games & markets
skills.description: Projections, scenarios, official evidence, impacts, and market history
examples: Project tonight's TOR vs MTL matchup
Find model-market disagreements for tomorrow's slate

skills.name: Live & pregame
skills.description: Live game state, situation model, commentary, live edges, and pregame availability
examples: What are the live win probabilities in this game?
Who are the announced starting goalies tonight?

skills.name: Standings
skills.description: Official tables, power standings, and the projected playoff picture
examples: Where does the power model disagree with the standings?

skills.name: Simulations
skills.description: Stored season simulations, game by game
examples: What are each team's playoff odds?

skills.name: Scenarios
skills.description: Saved what-if experiments the caller owns and can recompute

skills.name: NHL data
skills.description: Base data ingested from the official NHL APIs
examples: List NHL teams with their records
Show the Bruins roster and injuries

skills.name: News
skills.description: Aggregated NHL headlines by team and player
examples: Latest NHL headlines about the Montreal Canadiens

skills.name: Reference
examples: List every power metric with its formula
